name: Champion Petfoods USA
old_description: Founded in a small town in Alberta, Canada, Champion has grown to be a key player in the premium pet food industry with products sold in over 90 countries. By focusing exclusively on crafting premium pet food, we perfect our recipes and innovate new, quality foods that help pets thrive for a lifetime.
about:
Champion Petfoods USA operates its U.S. headquarters in Auburn, Kentucky, while the company traces its origins to a small town in Alberta, Canada, where it began crafting premium pet foods in 1985. The business has grown from those roots into a global player in the premium pet nutrition sector.

The company manufactures two flagship brands—ORIJEN and ACANA—formulated by Ph.D.-level nutrition experts and veterinarians in what it describes as state-of-the-art kitchens. Recipes center on WholePrey animal ingredients sourced from a curated supplier network, with ORIJEN products containing up to 90 percent animal ingredients such as meat, poultry, and fish, while ACANA balances protein-rich meats with whole fruits and vegetables. The operation serves more than 90 countries across three major geographic regions.

Champion sells directly to pet lovers worldwide and supports independent and neighborhood pet retailers as a founding sponsor of IndiePet. Its collaboration with the University of Guelph, a leading veterinary medicine and animal science institution, underscores a focus on advancing pet nutrition science.

The company was built on a singular focus: crafting only premium pet food. That specialization drives a philosophy that excludes wheat, corn, and soy from recipes, prioritizing animal ingredients that mirror ancestral diets.
